description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement PARELDOR'S CADUCATRIX (Aquilan Shield, WP-C46): (once per battle, per army) at the start of any phase, this model heals D3+3 wounds. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, Command phase); setup privileges: P1 detachment Aquilan Shield, the Shield-Captain given Pareldor's Caducatrix and left on 2 of its 8 wounds, CP 0 for both. The Movement phase starts (setup privilege: PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)): the start-of-phase window opens for the Custodes player with the free PARELDOR'S CADUCATRIX card; a real click on 'Use on Shield-Captain' heals 4-6 wounds (D3+3) without CP and spends the enhancement for the battle.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Aquilan Shield"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
var u = GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A"]
u.meta["enhancements"] = ["Pareldor's Caducatrix"]
u.models[0]["current_wounds"] = 2
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)
return int(u.models[0].wounds)
